examples.label: Cookie consent notice with accept and essential-only choices
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-alert" site="Global" id="alert-cookie-consent" variant="bordered" rounded="large" padding="medium" icon="hero-shield-check" title="We use cookies" >

Essential cookies keep the site running. Optional ones tell us which pages people actually read, so we can spend our time on the ones that matter. You can change this from the footer whenever you like.

<.component component_name="chelekom-button" site="Global" type="button" variant="default" color="natural" size="small"> Accept all <.component component_name="chelekom-button" site="Global" type="button" variant="outline" color="natural" size="small"> Only essential

examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-alert" site="Global" id="alert-maintenance-window" variant="outline" kind={:info} rounded="large" padding="medium" icon="hero-wrench-screwdriver" title="Scheduled maintenance this Saturday" >

We are moving the database to a larger cluster. Publishing and the admin dashboard will be read-only while the work runs — your public pages stay online the entire time, and nothing needs to be done on your side.

Starts
Sat 16 May, 02:00 UTC
Expected duration
About 45 minutes
Affected
Editor and publishing
